projects.name: VibeSense — Pump Fault Diagnostics | PyTorch, ResNet, Transfer Learning, PCA, Computer Vision
Converted raw pump vibration time-series into spectrograms and fine-tuned a PyTorch ResNet to classify 11 fault types on the open ESPset benchmark, reaching 96% F1 on held-out units.
Applied robust PCA across 22 sensor channels to flag developing anomalies before failure, catching degradation patterns that threshold-based alarms missed entirely.
FlowSight — Smart Injection Dashboard | PyTorch, LSTM, Streamlit, Time-Series Forecasting
Trained a PyTorch LSTM on 3,767 hourly records across 3 reservoir zones to forecast per-zone injection rates 24 hours ahead, beating the tree-based baseline by 12% on RMSE.
Shipped a Streamlit dashboard where engineers adjust valve settings and see forecasted rates update per zone in real time, validated against 5 months of blind well data.
MudOps — Production ML Pipeline | Airflow, Spark, SageMaker, Kubernetes, MLflow, GitHub Actions
Orchestrated an Airflow pipeline that ingests 2,820 drilling records through Spark, trains six candidate models on SageMaker, and promotes the winner to a Kubernetes endpoint — all tracked in MLflow.
Configured GitHub Actions to rerun tests and compare the challenger against production on every push, blocking deployment unless MAE improves on held-out wells.
LogPilot — AI Formation Interpreter | LangChain, RAG, ChromaDB, Prompt Engineering, LLM Evaluation
Built a LangChain RAG agent over 50+ chunked petrophysics documents in ChromaDB that takes a well name and depth and returns a plain-English formation interpretation with cited sources.
Evaluated retrieval quality with RAGAS and cut hallucination from 18% to under 4% by adding a self-query filter on formation age and a reranking step before generation.
